none_means: No qualifying prior reference verified; not a proof of novelty.

problem_class.label: nonconvex
problem_class.details: The objective f on ℝᵈ may be nonconvex. Its gradient is globally L-Lipschitz, its infimum f⋆ is finite, and f(x₀) − f⋆ ≤ Δ. The infimum need not be attained.

oracle.label: stochastic_gradient
oracle.details: Each call at an adaptively chosen x returns only g(x, ξ) for a fresh i.i.d. real seed ξ. The jointly measurable map g satisfies E[g(x, ξ)] = ∇f(x). The algorithm knows d, L, σ, Δ, ε, δ, and x₀. It accesses the hidden objective through oracle replies, with g and the seed law also hidden.
oracle.evidence: LongTails/Setups/HighDimensionalHighProbabilityStationarity.lean, Params, toGeneral, spec.publicInput, spec.Query, and spec.Reply. LongTails/Setups/HighProbabilityStationarity.lean, spec.admissible. LongTails/Setups/StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.lean, IID.

distinctive_assumptions.label: bounded_variance
distinctive_assumptions.details: For every x, E[‖g(x, ξ) − ∇f(x)‖²] ≤ σ², with σ ≥ 0. This second-moment condition permits heavy-tailed errors and includes σ = 0.

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: Queries, replies, and outputs lie in Euclidean ℝᵈ. The regime requires L > 0, ε > 0, 2⁵⁴ε² ≤ LΔ, and d ≥ 2⁴⁰[1 + (LΔ/ε²)(1 + σ²/ε²)]⁴. The dimension threshold is independent of δ.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/HighDimensionalHighProbabilityStationarity.lean, toGeneral, spec.Query, spec.Reply, spec.Output, and spec.valid.

accuracy.label: gradient_norm
accuracy.details: The algorithm returns one measurable point X in ℝᵈ. Success is evaluated at that output by the unsquared Euclidean gradient norm ‖∇f(X)‖ ≤ ε.

accuracy.label: high_probability
accuracy.details: With a fixed oracle-call budget, the output must satisfy P(‖∇f(X)‖ ≤ ε) ≥ 1 − δ for every admissible instance, where 0 < δ ≤ 1/4. The probability includes the independent algorithm and oracle randomness.
accuracy.evidence: LongTails/Setups/HighDimensionalHighProbabilityStationarity.lean, spec.valid and spec.successful. LongTails/Setups/HighProbabilityStationarity.lean, spec.successful. LongTails/Template.lean, executeWithTrace and Convergence.

setup_category.label: classical
setup_category.reason: Finding an ε-stationary point of a smooth, lower-bounded objective with an unbiased, bounded-variance stochastic gradient is a standard oracle-complexity benchmark. This formulation specifies the output confidence and the dimension regime for a randomized lower bound.
